Here are the best places to buy Korean skincare in Kuwait (mix of in‑store and online options):

## In Kuwait (physical stores)
- **Boots (Kuwait)** – Often stocks popular K‑beauty brands and Korean-made skincare; selection varies by branch.
- **Pharmacies & beauty chains** – Large branches in major malls sometimes carry Korean brands or Korean-made lines (stock differs a lot by location).
- **Korean/Japanese grocery stores & minimarkets** – Some carry a small skincare section (sheet masks, cleansers, sunscreen). If you tell me your area, I can suggest where to check first.

## Online (deliver to Kuwait)
- **YesStyle** – Wide K‑beauty range; usually reliable international shipping to Kuwait.
- **StyleKorean** – Big selection and frequent discounts; ships internationally.
- **Olive Young Global** – Official retailer with many mainstream Korean brands; ships to Kuwait.
- **Jolse** – Often good prices and bundles; ships internationally.
- **iHerb** – Not exclusively Korean, but carries a number of Korean brands and usually has fast shipping.

## Kuwait-based online beauty retailers/marketplaces
- **Boutiqaat**, **Taw9eel**, **Talabat Mart**, and similar local marketplaces sometimes list Korean skincare (availability changes). If buying from marketplaces, check seller ratings and authenticity notes.

### Quick tips to avoid fakes
- Prefer official retailers (Olive Young, brand official stores) or well-known sites (YesStyle/StyleKorean).
- Check batch/expiry, packaging details, and reviews.
- Be cautious of “too cheap” listings on marketplaces.

If you tell me **which area you’re in (e.g., Salmiya, Hawally, Kuwait City)** and **which brands/products you want** (Anua, COSRX, Beauty of Joseon, Round Lab, etc.), I can narrow it down to the most likely stores and the fastest/cheapest shipping options.
